rows.text: For the last four days water to our building (Sai Krupa Apartments, 3rd Cross, Vidyaranyapura) comes only about ten minutes in the morning and pressure is so low it never reaches the overhead tank, the buildings on either side are getting normal supply so something is wrong with our valve
rows.summary: Water supply to Sai Krupa Apartments limited to 10 minutes with low pressure unable to reach overhead tank for 4 days.
rows.note: PAIR 1A - piped drinking water pressure, one building, alternate arrangement still possible, so medium.
